5d952dd8c5.rewrite:
movzx eax,BYTE PTR [rdi]
lea rdi,[rdi+0x1]
xchg BYTE PTR [rsi-0x10],al
mov BYTE PTR [rsi],al
lea rsi,[rsi+0x1]
sub rdx,0x1
5d952dd8c5.why: XCHG combines reading the old byte at [rsi-0x10] with storing the input byte there, leaving the old byte in AL for the second store. RAX and RCX are not preserved, and the pointer updates and final subtraction retain the required registers and ZF.
